blocked_items.description: Authoritative Invariant Register machinery is not yet established.

The nine production MOT capacities have proposed canonical LIM-* identities and verified runtime mappings. Completion requires full normative LR population, schema, applicability and authority reconciliation.

Deterministic numerical limit derivation and effective configuration representation exist. Completion requires authoritative Effective Limit Manifest adoption, full applicable LIM-* coverage and qualification.
Common M0 diagnostics foundation is incomplete; current failure classifications are subsystem-local.

A deterministic build-specific configuration identity exists and is bound to the canonical production limit mappings. Completion requires authoritative configuration adoption, complete dependency/provenance reconciliation and applicable normative qualification.

notes: Runtime & Memory §78 implementation machinery is substantially present.
This record SHALL NOT be interpreted as M0 qualification or closure.
Formal closure requires all mandatory M0 blockers to receive valid dispositions.

M0-BLOCK-QRR implementation-authority blocker disposition: the canonical 234-rule QRR is populated from six controlled slices; existing QRR authority and qualification-foundation validators passed. Normative rule execution and milestone qualification remain independently subject to their applicable evidence requirements.

M0-BLOCK-IR progress: the complete inventory of 144 normative INV-* source statements from Invariants & Limits Register v0.3 is now under repository control. The existing 11-entry runtime READY implementation trace is distinct from this normative inventory. Applicability, implementation mappings and qualification dispositions remain to be reconciled before IR authority and M0 closure.

M0 configuration progress: a deterministic effective configuration identity is derived from the production binary, NASM-resolved nine-entry MOT projection, exact configured capacities and dependency provenance. Its numerical implementation projection is published and independently reproducible. Normative LIM-* mapping, authoritative ELM adoption, applicability and formal qualification remain outstanding.

M0-BLOCK-LR progress: nine M0 production MOT capacities now have stable proposed canonical LIM-MEM identities, exact NASM-resolved runtime mappings and verified numerical values. Full normative LR schema, applicability and authoritative adoption are still outstanding.

M0 production configuration reconciliation: all nine NASM-resolved MOT limits now reference the corresponding provisional canonical LIM-MEM identities without unresolved mapping placeholders. The effective configuration identity commits to the validated Limit Register bytes. These are implementation evidence, not a claim of full normative LR or ELM adoption.
